label: Every per se ordered efficient-cause link is a PER_SE_5 actual CAUSE_2 of being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: whenever c causes x as a caused cause (CausesAsCaused, the per se link of the secunda via's series of efficient causes, DEF 4a101a4c), c is a per se actual cause of the being of x in the q.3 a.4 profile (PerSeActualEsseCause, PER_SE_5, DEF 4bca086d): c is other than x, both are in act as to being, c causes the esse of x (CausesIn c x esse, CAUSE_2, mode unspecified, tenseless), and it does so as caused (the primitive per se link AsCaused c x). It reads the secunda via's per se series as a series of per se causes of being, the existential reading of the second way. It is not stated for accidentally ordered causes. Substantive objection on a respect-free reading of CausesAsCaused: Aquinas's own per se example in ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 (the stone moved by the stick, moved by the hand) is a per se ordered series of causes of motion, and the hand is not a cause of the stick's being, since the stick continues to be when the hand lets go; the bridge then fails at that link. It is defensible only where the per se links are themselves causes of being.
